dataFlow: The project file src/GcasE2ETestApi/GcasE2ETestApi.csproj includes a reference to the SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 library through the Microsoft.Data.Sqlite package, which is a transitive dependency. This dependency is vulnerable and can be exploited if the application processes untrusted input, leading to potential execution of malicious code.
rootCause: The vulnerable dependency SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 (version 2.1.10) is included indirectly via the Microsoft.Data.Sqlite package, which is specified in line 11 of the project file.
securityImpact: The vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code, compromising the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the application and its data.
proposedFix: Update the Microsoft.Data.Sqlite package to a version that does not include the vulnerable SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 dependency, or explicitly exclude the vulnerable library if possible.
summary: The root cause of the vulnerability is the inclusion of a vulnerable dependency (SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3) through the Microsoft.Data.Sqlite package, which poses a significant security risk.
